hadith.name: Hadith API (fawazahmed0/hadith-api)
hadith.note: Arabic text and English and Urdu translations are provided by the upstream dataset and matched by hadith number. Translator attribution is not included in the upstream Urdu edition metadata. Always verify wording with a qualified scholar or the original Arabic text.

duas.name: Hisn al-Muslim — OpenDua edition (data v0.0.4)
duas.author: Said ibn Ali ibn Wahf Al-Qahtani

tafsir.name: Quran Foundation Content API
tafsir.note: Tafsir passages are displayed verbatim from their selected edition and are never generated or paraphrased by NoorHub.

prayerTimes.name: Adhan.js
prayerTimes.note: Astronomical prayer time calculation performed locally in the browser. No location data is sent to a server.

hijriCalendar.name: Intl.DateTimeFormat — islamic-umalqura calendar
hijriCalendar.note: Tabular/Umm al-Qura conversion. Local moon sighting may differ by a day.

nisab.name: Gold API
nisab.note: Spot gold (XAU) and silver (XAG) prices used for nisab estimation.
